_doc: Tier-5 wilderness dungeon for random worlds (site remote: far from the drop site, min_danger 4). The Corvane Field Lab: Corvane Mining Co.'s geology field station that the Cordon took for its forward Bloom lab, a compound of ~54 m a side behind razor wire (lab_fence props; the guard hut stands in the south fence line, the containment block in the north one). Prefab lab modules on piers (kit rooms under lab_module_shell props, roof none) along a covered boardwalk (an open-sided kit room under lab_boardwalk_roof props), the decontamination unit (lab_decon_shell), the core shed, the mess and bunkhouse, the generator shed, and the containment block half dug into the hill (lab_berm props) over a buried level (ADR-0007 cellar): the containment suite behind a keycard airlock, the isolation ward, the specimen lab and the specimen vault (ADR-0026 vault lock), with the escape shaft's ladder up to the bolted escape hatch beyond the wire. Route: the road -> the cut in the wire (jaws) -> the core shed -> the boardwalk (loose boards) -> sample prep -> microscopy -> the mess -> the manager's room (station keys) -> the padlocked admin module -> the office behind its alarm (containment key) -> the cold room (keycard) -> the chained decon unit -> shower -> airlock -> stair hall -> the biosafety office -> down -> the isolation ward -> the keycard airlock -> the containment suite -> the specimen lab (vault code) -> the vault (shotgun; Torvald, guardian) -> the escape shaft -> up the ladder -> unbolt the escape hatch. Written by build/agentY/gen_lab.py; see docs/POI_AUTHORING.md and ADR-0046.

defs.story: Field Station 2 was Corvane Mining Co.'s geology camp at the end of the exploration road: a core shed, a bunkhouse and three prefab labs on piers where Ted Brask's crew logged the deep holes. When the bore broke into the caves they brought the first cores here, BH-7 from fourteen hundred feet, threaded with something pale. Inside a month the Cordon Medical Authority had taken the station for its forward lab: Dr. Celia Marchetti's team, a decontamination line, a containment block dug into the hillside with airlocks, isolation cells and a vault for the samples, and Biosafety Officer Ines Torvald to hold the line. Station manager Anders Lindqvist stayed on to run the generators. The orders were to keep the cores at minus eighty and the station sealed until the Program collected them. Nobody came. On the second Hum the containment suite filled with the people it was built to protect; Torvald shut herself in the vault with the cores rather than open it, and the station fell with Marchetti's people still at their benches. A month later Remand Salvager #3907 cut the wire to fetch the samples. His tether still talks from the core shed.

route.label: The exploration road ends at a chained gate in razor wire: CORVANE MINING CO. FIELD STATION 2, the Cordon's BIOHAZARD plates; the guard hut is bolted from inside
Round the wire to where someone cut it: the flap peeled back, jaws in the grass
The core shed: racks of core boxes, the saw, the logging benches; a Remand salvager under the bench (the geologists rise)
The covered boardwalk between the lab modules: loose boards
Sample prep: the fume hood, the benches (the technicians wake as the door opens)
Microscopy: Dr. Marchetti's sample log
Across the yard, the mess: the crew still at the tables
The manager's room: his keys on the hook, his footlocker (the bunks stir)
The admin module, padlocked: the radio room and the station log
Lindqvist's office behind its alarm: the Cordon's orders, the containment key
The cold room: Marchetti's keycard by her freezers (the cold room wakes)
The decontamination unit: chained shut; PPE racks inside (jaws in the suits)
Through the decon shower to the airlock: ONE DOOR AT A TIME
The biosafety officer's office: Torvald's last entries
The buried level
The isolation ward: the Corvane men on their cots
The containment airlock: the card reader
The containment suite and its cells (the suite rises)
The specimen lab: the vault code under the clipboard (Marchetti's last two wake)
Dial the specimen vault (a wire behind its door): Torvald and the Bloom cores
The escape shaft: up the ladder into the escape hatch
Draw the bolt: out on the hillside, beyond the wire
